name: cl_fx_disp15_vwap_10to11_short

source.title: Claude 2026-10-20 control: the 10:00-11:00 15m displacement with the VWAP-side gate, SHORT side only, against random short entries (drift control)

entry.words: From 10:00 to 11:00 ET, a 15-minute candle whose body is at least 1.5 x ATR(14) of the candles before it is a displacement. Enter at its close in its direction, long only when the close is above the session VWAP (anchored at 09:30) and short only when below it. Stop at the displacement candle's other extreme, target 1:1. One trade a day.

taught: [owner 2026-10-15, sheet displace_ema15_1r_10to11_k1p5] displacement = body >= k x ATR(14) of the candles before, followed at its close
[owner 2026-10-15, same sheet] stop = the displacement candle's other extreme; target 1:1; one trade a day
[owner 2026-10-19, sheet cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1] trade on the day's side (there: the 09:30 open)
[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] the side = the session VWAP since 09:30 (gate vwap_dev, line 0) in place of the 15-minute EMA20; k 1.5; entries 10:00-11:00
not_run: THE VWAP: the engine's session VWAP of the nyam pass, anchored at 09:30 ET, read at the signal close (closed bars only).
WINDOW: decisions at the 15-minute closes 10:00, 10:15, 10:30 and 10:45; the nyam pass ends 11:00.
THE CAP: the first displacement on the VWAP's side is the trade; one a day.
A stop floor of 0.25 x ATR applies when the candle's extreme is nearer than that.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
